text.p: Checkpoint Systems Inc said Monday that it has secured two contracts to install its radio frequency electronic article surveillance systems that are worth a combined total of about $20 million, over several years.
A company spokesman told Reuters that Checkpoint said that its contract to install the systems in American Stores Co's 1,650 operations nationwide is worth about $16 million over "several" years.
The spokesman said that the value of the American Stores deal, plus an additional contract to install the sytems in Bi-Lo Inc stores, is about $20 million over several years.
The American Stores Company contract is the largest in Checkpoint's history, the company said.
Checkpoint's systems are already installed in 55 Bi-Lo stores and the contract calls for installation in the company's remaining 205 stores, it said.
Bi-Lo Inc is a division of Koninklijke Ahold NV.
